title: Imagine My Kitchen Renovation
tests: Generates a source-faithful renovation from one photo and combines it with the untouched original in a labeled comparison.

faults.what: The result is not a side-by-side comparison: the original fills nearly the entire image, while the renovation is only a small thumbnail in the upper-right corner.
The Before and After labels overlap in a large dark box over the original kitchen rather than identifying their respective panels.
The renovated thumbnail appears to replace the original rear and right-hand sink areas with uninterrupted counters, failing to preserve major fixture positions.
The finished image is approximately 5:3 rather than the requested 16:9.

judge.summary: The output leaves the original kitchen full-size with a tiny renovation inset and overlapping labels instead of delivering the requested 16:9 side-by-side comparison.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 image shows the supplied original kitchen on the left and a visibly renovated version on the right.
must_haves.why: The image is not 16:9 and uses a small upper-right inset rather than left and right comparison panels.

must_haves.item: The left photo retains its brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter.
must_haves.why: The large original photograph retains the brown cabinets, beige tiles, and countertop clutter, although it is not confined to a left panel.

must_haves.item: The right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles and uncluttered counters.
must_haves.why: The renovation inset visibly shows white framed cabinets, light wood counters, white horizontal tile, and clear countertops, though it is far too small to function as the requested right panel.

must_haves.item: The generated kitchen preserves the original room geometry, major fixture positions and camera viewpoint rather than showing a different kitchen.
must_haves.why: The inset retains a broadly similar U-shaped room and window position, but the original sink fixtures are not preserved.

must_haves.item: Readable labels say exactly 'Before' above or within the left panel and 'After' above or within the right panel.
must_haves.why: Both words are rendered on top of each other over the original image; neither correctly labels a separate comparison panel.
